title: Purple Sorceress
description: A young woman with light purple hair and purple eyes stands in a dynamic pose against a plain gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with armored elements, wields a glowing purple energy orb in her right hand and a crackling purple energy whip in her left, with a radiant purple halo of lightning floating above her head.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian woman with pale purple hair tied in a topknot and bangs, glowing purple eyes, wearing a white and purple traditional martial arts outfit with armored plates and flowing sashes. She is in a combat stance, holding a swirling purple energy whip in one hand and projecting a glowing purple orb of magic from the other. A crackling purple lightning halo floats above her head. Clean digital painting style, solid gray background, dynamic pose, vibrant purple and white color scheme.
